description: Implementation of the VertexArray class and related state management for GLES 3 Vertex Array Objects in ANGLE project.

classes.name: VertexArray
classes.description: Represents a GLES 3 Vertex Array Object, managing vertex attributes, buffers, and state synchronization.

classes.name: VertexArrayState
classes.description: Holds the state of vertex attributes and bindings within a VertexArray.

classes.name: IndexRangeCache
classes.description: Caches index range computations for element array buffers.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the VertexArray is destroyed, releasing buffers and deleting the object.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the VertexArray for debugging or identification.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the VertexArray.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from the VertexArray by buffer ID.

methods.name: getVertexAttribute
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific vertex attribute.

methods.name: getVertexBinding
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific vertex binding.

methods.name: GetVertexIndexFromDirtyBit
methods.description: Maps a dirty bit to a vertex attribute index.

methods.name: setDirtyAttribBit
methods.description: Marks a vertex attribute as dirty.

methods.name: setDirtyBindingBit
methods.description: Marks a vertex binding as dirty.

methods.name: updateCachedBufferBindingSize
methods.description: Updates cached size info for a buffer binding.

methods.name: updateCachedMappedArrayBuffers
methods.description: Updates cache of mapped array buffers based on their mapped state.

methods.name: updateCachedMappedArrayBuffersBinding
methods.description: Updates cache for a specific buffer binding.

methods.name: updateCachedTransformFeedbackBindingValidation
methods.description: Checks for conflicts with transform feedback bindings.

methods.name: bindVertexBufferImpl
methods.description: Binds a buffer to a vertex buffer binding point, updating cache and state.

methods.name: bindVertexBuffer
methods.description: Public method to bind a buffer to a vertex buffer binding point.

methods.name: setVertexAttribBinding
methods.description: Sets the binding point for a vertex attribute.

methods.name: setVertexBindingDivisor
methods.description: Sets the divisor for instanced rendering on a buffer binding.

methods.name: setVertexAttribFormat
methods.description: Sets the format of a vertex attribute.

methods.name: setVertexAttribDivisor
methods.description: Sets the divisor for a vertex attribute.

methods.name: enableAttribute
methods.description: Enables or disables a vertex attribute.

methods.name: setVertexAttribPointer
methods.description: Defines an array of vertex attribute data.

methods.name: setVertexAttribIPointer
methods.description: Defines an array of integer vertex attribute data.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the state of the VertexArray with the backend.

methods.name: onBindingChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when a buffer binding changes.

methods.name: getDirtyBitFromIndex
methods.description: Determines the dirty bit for a given buffer index.

methods.name: onSubjectStateChange
methods.description: Handles notifications of state changes from observed subjects.

methods.name: setDependentDirtyBit
methods.description: Sets a dirty bit based on a change in a buffer or attribute.

methods.name: hasTransformFeedbackBindingConflict
methods.description: Checks for conflicts with transform feedback buffers.

methods.name: getIndexRangeImpl
methods.description: Computes the index range for draw calls, considering element array buffers.
